label: Rio de Janeiro and Paraty
blurb: 9 days in May: granite peaks, beaches and a colonial town.

brief.text: I want the big Rio views from the granite peaks, the beaches at sunrise and the street life in the old neighbourhoods. After that, a few slower days in Paraty for the colonial streets and the bay. I am happy to hike for a view.

answer.title: Rio de Janeiro and Paraty in May
answer.summary: Five nights in Ipanema cover the big granite viewpoints, the beaches at sunrise and sunset, and the street life of Lapa, Centro and the port. A coach down the Costa Verde then gives four slower days in Paraty for the colonial centre, the bay and two hikes, to Mamanguá and Trindade.

base.label: Historic centre, near Praça da Matriz

spots.name: Ipanema Beach at Posto 9
spots.when: Afternoon, beach life at its peak
spots.tip: Walk the hard sand at the waterline and shoot back towards the beach crowd, volleyball and vendors with the 70-200. Dois Irmãos closes the frame to the west.

spots.name: Arpoador Rock
spots.when: Sunset, from the top of the rock
spots.tip: Climb to the upper ledge and look west along Ipanema to Dois Irmãos and Pedra da Gávea. Turn round for the crowd lined up on the rock against the sky.

spots.name: Christ the Redeemer
spots.tip: Take the first Corcovado train from Cosme Velho and shoot the statue from the lower steps before the platform fills. Then turn to Sugarloaf and Guanabara Bay with the 70-200.

spots.name: Selarón Steps
spots.tip: Stand a few steps up from Rua Joaquim Silva and frame the tiled stairs rising into Santa Teresa. People posing on the steps are part of the picture here.

spots.name: Parque das Ruínas
spots.when: Late afternoon, low sun on the bay
spots.tip: Climb to the top terrace of the ruined mansion for Guanabara Bay with Sugarloaf on the horizon. The 70-200 compresses the Centro towers against the bay.

spots.name: Lapa Arches
spots.when: Weekend night, street life under the arches
spots.tip: Shoot from Largo da Lapa with the floodlit arches behind the crowd and the street stalls. Fast primes and a raised ISO handle the light.

spots.name: Copacabana fishermen's colony
spots.tip: Stand on the sand by the fishing boats at Posto 6 with the sun rising over the sea and the curve of Copacabana towards Leme. Ask before close portraits of the fishermen.

spots.name: Sugarloaf Mountain
spots.when: Sunset into the first city lights
spots.tip: Ride up an hour before sunset, stop on Morro da Urca, then take the second cable car to the summit deck. Frame Botafogo Bay with Christ the Redeemer on Corcovado as the lights come on.

spots.name: Mureta da Urca
spots.tip: Brace the camera on the wall and shoot across the moored boats to the lights of Botafogo and the lit statue on Corcovado. Locals sitting on the wall make the foreground.

spots.name: Pedra do Telégrafo
spots.when: Early morning, before the queue builds
spots.tip: From the summit, shoot the restinga and beaches of Guaratiba with the 24-70. The famous hanging shot is a camera-angle trick over a short drop; people queue to take turns, so offer to shoot for the person ahead.

spots.name: Etnias mural, Boulevard Olímpico
spots.when: Late afternoon, sun on the warehouse wall
spots.tip: Step back across the boulevard to fit the whole mural in, then walk closer and use passers-by and cyclists for scale.

spots.name: Pedra do Sal
spots.tip: Stand on the rock steps above the square for the musicians and dancers below. Use the 35mm wide open and keep shutter speeds above 1/125 for the dancers.

spots.name: Royal Portuguese Reading Room
spots.tip: Stand at the far end of the reading room under the chandelier and shoot back towards the entrance to get the three tiers of books and the skylight.

spots.name: Confeitaria Colombo
spots.tip: Take a table near the back and shoot along the room to catch the Belgian mirrors repeating the waiters and diners. A coffee buys the time to work.

spots.name: Dois Irmãos summit
spots.tip: From the top, frame Ipanema and Leblon running towards Sugarloaf with the Lagoa behind. Turn west for Pedra da Gávea and the Vidigal rooftops in the last light.

spots.name: Rodrigo de Freitas Lagoon
spots.localName: Lagoa Rodrigo de Freitas, Parque dos Patins
spots.when: Sunrise, while the water is still
spots.tip: Shoot from the shore at Parque dos Patins across the lagoon to Corcovado with the statue on top. Rowers and runners crossing the frame give scale.

spots.name: Santa Rita Church
spots.tip: Stand at the waterfront south of the church for the white facade with the boats and the green hills behind. Stay into blue hour when the church lights come on.

spots.name: Paraty historic centre
spots.tip: Walk Rua do Comércio and the lanes around Praça da Matriz while they are empty and shoot low along the cobbles to the coloured doorways. The 35mm suits the narrow lanes.

spots.name: Defensor Perpétuo Fort
spots.when: Late afternoon, low sun over the bay
spots.tip: Walk up from Praia do Pontal and shoot past the cannons to the bay and its islands. The 70-200 picks out schooners on the water.

spots.name: Our Lady of Remedies Church
spots.localName: Igreja Matriz de Nossa Senhora dos Remédios
spots.tip: Shoot from the far side of Praça da Matriz with the lit facade above the people in the square. Clamp to a bench or railing for a steady frame.

spots.name: Saco do Mamanguá viewpoint
spots.tip: From the top, look south down the full length of the narrow inlet with the mangroves at its end. A polariser cuts the glare on the water.

spots.name: Jabaquara Beach
spots.tip: Walk out onto the wet tidal flats and use the reflections of the hills and the moored boats. A low angle doubles the sky.

spots.name: Cachadaço natural pool, Trindade
spots.when: Morning, at low tide and calm sea
spots.tip: Climb onto the boulders on the seaward side and shoot down into the pool with the jungle-covered hill behind. Swimmers in the green water give scale.

spots.name: Tobogã waterfall
spots.tip: Stand on the rocks beside the lower pool and use the 70-200 for the sliders coming down the smooth granite. A fast shutter freezes the splash.

spots.name: Paraty pier
spots.when: Late afternoon, as the schooners return
spots.tip: Walk to the end of the pier and shoot back at the painted schooners with the church and the hills behind. The 70-200 isolates crews tying up.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.why: A gentle first outing with the beach crowd close to the base.

slots.label: Sunset
slots.why: Rio's best-known sunset rock is a short walk along the beach.
slots.note: Pickpocketing is common in the sunset crowd; keep the camera on a strap.

slots.label: Morning
slots.why: The first train gets the statue and the bay view before the platform fills.
slots.note: Buy timed train tickets in advance, and check the forecast first: cloud often sits on the summit.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.why: Colour, tiles and people at a walk from Lapa.

slots.label: Late afternoon
slots.why: Low light on Guanabara Bay and Sugarloaf, a short climb above the steps.

slots.label: Night
slots.why: Saturday night under the arches is the city's liveliest street scene.
slots.note: Carry only the camera you use and take an app car back rather than walking side streets.

days.title: Fishermen at dawn, Sugarloaf at dusk

slots.label: Morning
slots.why: Sunrise over the sea with working boats and people in the frame.

slots.label: Sunset
slots.why: The must-see summit at its best light, into the first city lights.

slots.label: Night
slots.why: Walk down from the cable car station for night lights over Botafogo Bay.

days.title: Pedra do Telégrafo and the Monday samba

slots.label: Morning
slots.why: A real hike to a big landscape view, with a short weekday queue.
slots.note: Start from Barra de Guaratiba, 60 to 90 minutes by car from Ipanema; the climb takes under an hour.

slots.label: Late afternoon
slots.why: Street art at port-district scale before the samba starts nearby.

slots.label: Night
slots.why: Live samba in the oldest corner of the port district.
slots.note: Arrive and leave by app car and avoid walking the surrounding streets after dark.

days.title: Old Centro and Dois Irmãos at sunset

slots.label: Morning
slots.why: Rio's finest heritage interior, quiet before tour groups arrive.

slots.label: Midday
slots.why: A Belle Époque interior full of people, a short walk away.

slots.label: Sunset
slots.why: The classic hike for the whole south zone in one frame.
slots.note: The trail starts at the top of Vidigal; go with a local guide and bring a headlamp for the descent.

days.title: Down the Costa Verde to Paraty

travel.label: Costa Verde coach from Novo Rio bus station

slots.label: Morning
slots.why: Calm water and Corcovado at sunrise, close to the base before the bus.

slots.label: Sunset
slots.why: Paraty's signature church on the water, a short walk from the bus station.

days.title: Paraty streets, the fort and the Matriz

slots.label: Morning
slots.why: The must-see colonial streets, empty at first light.

slots.label: Late afternoon
slots.why: Bay and islands in low sun from a short climb north of town.

slots.label: Night
slots.why: The floodlit main church and the square in the evening.

slots.label: Morning
slots.why: A boat and a steep hike for the best landscape view on the coast.
slots.note: Book a boat from Paraty-Mirim to Praia do Cruzeiro; the climb is about an hour and steep, so start early and carry water.

slots.label: Sunset
slots.why: Reflections on the tidal flats, a short ride from the centre.

slots.label: Morning
slots.why: A hike through the forest to a clear sea pool, before the weekend crowd.
slots.note: The trail from Praia do Meio crosses rocks and takes about 30 minutes; swim only when the sea is calm.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.why: Saturday brings locals to the rock slide, which makes the picture.

slots.label: Late afternoon
slots.why: Schooners coming back from the bay in warm light.

skipped.name: Pedra da Gávea
skipped.reason: A full-day climb with an exposed rock section that needs a guide and rope; Dois Irmãos and Pedra do Telégrafo give big views with less risk.

skipped.name: Mirante Dona Marta
skipped.reason: Repeats the bay and Sugarloaf view already covered from Corcovado and Parque das Ruínas.

skipped.name: Pedra Bonita
skipped.reason: The hang-gliding ramp view over São Conrado overlaps with Dois Irmãos.

skipped.name: Ilha Grande
skipped.reason: Needs two nights on its own to justify the transfer.
